concept.title: What is the NC State VPN
concept.shortdesc: What is NC State's VPN service and how do you securely access internal campus resources from off-campus locations using Cisco Secure Client.

conbody.p: The NC State Virtual Private Network (VPN) service provides authorized users with secure network access to internal campus resources while off campus or not directly connected to the university's network. NC State provides this service through the Cisco Secure Client software.
All NC State students, faculty, and staff are eligible to access the NC State VPN service, though common use cases vary by campus role:

ul.li: Students: Connect to the VPN from off campus to access restricted university library databases, course software, and class servers.
Faculty and Staff: Connect to the VPN when working remotely to access internal departmental drives, research storage, and administrative or HR systems.

conbody.note: All NC State VPN service users are subject to NC State's Use of IT Resources Policy and VPN Acceptable Use Policy. You must also be enrolled in Duo two-factor authentication (2FA) to sign in to the VPN.
